title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at CUNY City College, from historic halls and rooftop terraces to student-only fitness centers and public park events.

cards.title: Visit the Historic Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Historic assembly space in Shepard Hall
cards.notes: Walk through this neo-Gothic hall to see the 'The Graduate' mural. It is a quiet, awe-inspiring spot for reflection between classes when not in use for events.
cards.short_summary: A historic, cathedral-like assembly hall featuring a massive mural and neo-Gothic architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Hall in Shepard Hall is a historic space with a capacity of 600-1,000 and features the mural 'The Graduate'.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours (typically 7am-10pm) unless reserved for private ceremonies or lectures.

cards.title: Work Out at Wingate
cards.subtitle: Free gym for CCNY students
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access cardio machines, free weights, and an indoor track. It is a cost-free alternative to commercial gym memberships in Harlem.
cards.short_summary: A 6,000-square-foot fitness facility offering free gym access to the City College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wingate Fitness Center is open to all members of the City College community for free with a valid CCNY I.D.
cards.source_title: Wingate Fitness Center - Facilities - The City College of New York Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8am-8pm and Friday 8am-4pm during the spring semester. Valid CCNY ID required.

cards.title: Relax on the Spitzer Rooftop
cards.subtitle: Outdoor terrace and amphitheater
cards.notes: Head to the roof of the Spitzer School for skyline views. Use the amphitheater seating for study groups or a quiet lunch break in the open air.
cards.short_summary: An elevated outdoor space featuring a paved terrace and amphitheater seating for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spitzer School rooftop amphitheater and terrace are open to students, faculty, and staff from 7am to 6pm, Monday through Friday.
cards.source_title: Rooftop and Amphitheater - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the main atrium staircase or freight elevator. Open weekdays 7am-6pm.

cards.title: Study on the Quiet Floors
cards.subtitle: Silent study zones in North Academic Center
cards.notes: Find a desk on the 4th or 5th floors for guaranteed silence. These floors are dedicated to focused work without the distraction of group chatter.
cards.short_summary: Designated silent study areas located on the upper floors of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: In Cohen Library, the 4th and 5th floors are designated for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Can I use the library space to take online classes? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during library operating hours; valid CUNY ID required for entry.

cards.title: Hang Out in St. Nicholas Park
cards.subtitle: Public park bordering the campus
cards.notes: Walk down the stairs from St. Nicholas Terrace to reach the park's lawns. It is a popular spot for outdoor reading and community events like Harlem Week.
cards.short_summary: A 23-acre public park adjacent to the CCNY campus offering lawns, sports courts, and historic sites.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Nicholas Park is a public park bordering the CCNY campus and hosts various free community events.

cards.title: Browse the Atrium Gallery
cards.subtitle: Architecture exhibits in the Spitzer School
cards.notes: View rotating architectural models and design exhibits in this light-filled atrium. The gallery showcases work from both students and professional architects.
cards.short_summary: A public exhibition space within the Spitzer School of Architecture featuring design-focused displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spitzer School Atrium Gallery hosts exhibits and is located at 141 Convent Avenue.
cards.source_title: Exhibits - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during building hours, typically 9am-5pm on weekdays.

cards.title: Attend a Talent Showcase
cards.subtitle: Student performances in the NAC
cards.notes: Check the Student Life calendar for free events like the CCNY Talent Showcase. These gatherings often include free refreshments and campus merchandise giveaways.
cards.short_summary: A large multi-purpose venue in the North Academic Center that hosts free student-led performances and fairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAC Ballroom hosts events like the CCNY Talent Showcase, which is free for students and includes merch and refreshments.
cards.source_title: Student Appreciation Day - Department of Student Life
cards.access_notes: Access is typically for CCNY students and staff; specific event times vary.

cards.title: Lounge on Marshak Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor recreation space
cards.notes: Utilize the renovated plaza for outdoor seating and recreation. It serves as a central bridge between the North Campus and the athletic facilities.
cards.short_summary: A newly renovated outdoor plaza featuring athletic courts, a running track, and seating areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marshak Hall Plaza renovation provides a new outdoor recreation center with athletic courts, a track, and seating.
cards.source_title: Marshak Hall Plaza - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; accessible from Convent Avenue and St. Nicholas Terrace.

cards.title: Socialize at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Lounge in NAC Room 6/289
cards.notes: Drop by the 6th floor of the NAC to meet other students. This lounge is designed for relaxing and socializing between classes in a casual environment.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student lounge on the 6th floor of the North Academic Center for meeting and relaxing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center in NAC room 6/289 is a place for all CCNY students to meet, study, and socialize.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday during standard academic hours.

cards.title: Get Free Writing Tutoring
cards.subtitle: Academic support in NAC 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Schedule a free session with a tutor to review your essays or lab reports. The center also offers computer stations for student use while you work.
cards.short_summary: An academic resource center providing free one-on-one tutoring and computer lab access for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center offers free tutoring and has 26 MACs and a computer lab for student use.
cards.source_title: The Writing Center | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; appointments are recommended but walk-ins may be available for computer use.
